trigger: AI cites a legacy/rejected design decision as current guidance
AI converts simulation or inference into an observed fact
Public-release asset has unknown rights or provenance
AI gives a structural/fire/electrical safety conclusion without qualified professional sign-off
required_actions: retain AI output as non-authoritative analysis only

trigger: Tool or MCP reports an ambiguous/partial result for an irreversible action
Same blocker recurs after one correction
required_actions: add regression case or revise skill/prompt

trigger: AI changes a locked geometry variable or loses unit/axis information
AI uses unauthorized personal/client data or exposes sensitive material outside allowed scope
Landscape/site analysis upgrades regional remote terrain, route topology or generalized slope/aspect into surveyed site geometry or field-measured topography.
required_actions: route required survey/topographic authority to the responsible professional source
reopen all landscape decisions consuming the false site geometry

trigger: A D8 flow-accumulation or terrain-convergence diagram is presented as a hydraulic drainage network, stormwater design or drainage-capacity proof without catchment/outfall/hydraulic evidence.
required_actions: relabel the result as terrain-convergence evidence only
route to the responsible Landscape/Civil/Hydraulic owner
identify catchment, outfall, overflow, maintenance and calculation evidence required before closure

trigger: A planting rendering, species-symbol plan or precedent palette is treated as professional planting resolution without soil, light, moisture, root-volume, mature-size, ecology, availability and maintenance evidence appropriate to the claim.
required_actions: separate graphic/compositional intent from planting-professional truth
route specialist review where responsibility is outside Landscape Architecture

trigger: Landscape handover or installation completion is reported as establishment success or mature landscape performance before required seasonal, defects, replacement, irrigation and maintenance evidence exists.
required_actions: retain maintenance/establishment owner and next readback condition
reopen any downstream claim that consumed false establishment completion

trigger: A stakeholder preference, persona, audience segment or design assumption is promoted to a researched user need/use requirement without participant/context evidence.
required_actions: identify the research question and evidence required
reopen design decisions that depended on the false user-need authority

trigger: Prototype static checks, producer design critique, visual polish or click-through completion are reported as usability PASS without representative-user task evaluation.
required_actions: define users, tasks, context and evaluation questions
route to representative-user usability evaluation and repair/retest

trigger: Accessible-looking UI, inclusive intent, contrast spot checks or responsive layout are reported as WCAG/accessibility conformance without evaluated criteria and assistive-technology/disabled-user evidence appropriate to the claim.
required_actions: run the applicable accessibility audit/testing route
route unresolved specialist/conformance questions to the responsible accessibility owner

trigger: Local-only storage, no-login design, a privacy notice or minimal permissions are treated as privacy/security/legal approval without specialist review of collection, retention, consent, access and threat implications.
required_actions: reopen affected interaction/research/instrumentation decisions when specialist findings arrive

trigger: An analytics event, click rate, funnel change or dashboard metric is treated as proof that a user outcome improved or that a design change caused the change without metric validity and causal evidence.
required_actions: route causal question to appropriate research/experiment evidence

trigger: Source-ready, build PASS, static browser checks or implementation artifact existence are reported as interactive-runtime/release HCD PASS despite missing actual browser/device/error/offline/accessibility readback.

User-research notes, recordings, prototype-entered data or participant details are collected/reused without an explicit consent, purpose, minimisation, access and retention boundary appropriate to the organisation and jurisdiction.
required_actions: contain affected research data according to responsible privacy/legal guidance
invalidate findings whose evidence cannot be lawfully or ethically retained/used

trigger: A required font, renderer, runtime, plugin, linked native asset or other dependency is unavailable, but the producer silently substitutes a fallback and still reports the artifact as reproducible, semantically faithful or final-delivery eligible.
required_actions: identify the missing material dependency and its requiredness
restore the declared fallback policy and dependency identity boundary
freeze final/delivery eligibility when a required dependency is unresolved
if an equivalent is explicitly authorized, record its identity and run actual readback before any new PASS

trigger: A required validation result in FAIL, HOLD, NOT_RUN or UNVERIFIED is converted to PASS by a generic waiver, exception flag, reviewer note or command-line override without changing the governing criterion/claim boundary through an authorized decision and rerunning validation.
required_actions: restore the original validation result as historical truth
resolve any material exception through the existing Decision Rights authorization basis for the exact decision object and scope
record the changed criterion/claim boundary if authorized and run a fresh validation before dependent completion

trigger: A fallback stack or preferred dependency list is interpreted as if its first font/runtime/library were an exclusive Current authority requirement, even though the governing Design/Source Authority only requires the dependency role or semantic fidelity.
required_actions: separate preferred dependency order from exact authority lock
resolve whether the governing Current actually requires exact identity or only a role/performance/fidelity condition
use ALLOW_DECLARED_EQUIVALENT when equivalents are authorized and require actual identity/readback rather than inventing a unique authority
reopen only claims that actually depended on exact identity
